## Knowledge-quality checklist

- [ ] I searched for an existing article before creating a new one.
- [ ] The article is in the most specific existing category.
- [ ] New filenames use lowercase kebab-case.
- [ ] Tags reuse existing spelling and capitalization.
- [ ] Facts, inferences, limitations, and follow-up are distinguishable.
- [ ] Commands use placeholders and contain no secrets or identifying data.
- [ ] Sources and supporting artifacts are safe, relevant, and linked.
- [ ] A clean Hexo build succeeds.
- [ ] Generated `docs/` files were not edited or committed manually.
